fields.notes: Two risks moved to **mitigating** this week. The county pilot depends on the redaction service, now *at risk*.

fields.title: If two inspectors edit the same report offline, then the later sync overwrites the earlier one and findings are lost.
fields.mitigation:
Field-level merge shipped in !218.

- Monitor conflict rate weekly
- Escalate if it passes 1%

fields.title: If county IT blocks the photo upload domain, then the pilot can't start on time.
fields.mitigation: Ask both pilot counties to allowlist the domain before go-live.

fields.title: Every inspector has a phone with a camera.
fields.impact: Photo capture needs a tablet fallback.

fields.title: Report export times out for reports with 200+ photos
fields.action: Stream the export instead of building it in memory.

fields.title: Photo redaction service in production
fields.notes: Asked at the roadmap review; no date yet.
